title: Orthogonal Doob martingale projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let a finite Fourier basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ be orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product and contain the constant-one function. For a nonnegative integer $n$, a function $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and a nonnegative integer $t$, the orthogonal Doob martingale at time $t$ is the projection of $f$ onto functions depending only on the first $t$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nonempty Fourier basis index set with decidable equality
A basis containing the constant-one function and orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of coordinate projection and the first-coordinate set, so the precise projection convention cannot be confirmed.
